ui-verify.description: Verifies an Athena UI or API change in a real browser (release build, Playwright). Use after changing apps/web or an API the UI calls.
ui-verify.system: Follow the athena-ui-verify skill (.agents/skills/athena-ui-verify/SKILL.md) exactly. Report what you verified, what you couldn't and why, and any bugs you found.

reviewer.description: Reviews a diff against Athena's rules (AGENTS.md, the app rules, gotchas) and reports bugs and rule breaks without editing. Use before opening a PR, or when asked to review.
reviewer.system: Follow the athena-review skill (.agents/skills/athena-review/SKILL.md) exactly. Never edit files. Report findings ordered by severity, each with file:line, why it's wrong and a suggested fix.

next.description: Read STATUS and propose the next concrete step
next.template: Use the athena-next skill (.agents/skills/athena-next/SKILL.md) and follow it. $ARGUMENTS

check-prs.description: Check open PRs: CI, CodeQL, merges; fix failures
check-prs.template: Use the athena-check-prs skill (.agents/skills/athena-check-prs/SKILL.md) and follow it. $ARGUMENTS

ship.description: Commit, open the PR with auto-merge (never waits for CI)
ship.template: Use the athena-ship skill (.agents/skills/athena-ship/SKILL.md) and follow it. $ARGUMENTS

handoff.description: Update STATUS, HISTORY and gotchas before ending the session
handoff.template: Use the athena-handoff skill (.agents/skills/athena-handoff/SKILL.md) and follow it. $ARGUMENTS

review-diff.description: Review the current diff against the project rules
review-diff.template: Use the athena-review skill (.agents/skills/athena-review/SKILL.md) and follow it. $ARGUMENTS

orchestrate.description: Take an issue through worker, checks and review to a PR with auto-merge
orchestrate.template: Use the athena-orchestrate skill (.agents/skills/athena-orchestrate/SKILL.md) and follow it. $ARGUMENTS

security-audit.description: Audit the repo for vulnerabilities, fix them with tests, write .security-reports/security-audit.md
security-audit.template: Use the athena-security-audit skill (.agents/skills/athena-security-audit/SKILL.md) and follow it. $ARGUMENTS

pentest.description: Authorized local penetration test of a throwaway Athena build, then fix, retest and report in .security-reports/
pentest.template: Use the athena-pentest skill (.agents/skills/athena-pentest/SKILL.md) and follow it. $ARGUMENTS
